name: Marquee
description: Half a fan, hung from one edge like the awning over a doorway.

code.style: --rule: ( --from: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 180deg at 50% 0%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 26deg); mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 180deg at 50% 0%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 26deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--from)); transform: rotate(@var(--from)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
